gaps.where: Every Admin area page (web /admin/*, phone More → Support desk) and the Sell HandsFreeOS page (/affiliate): there is no Ask HandsFreeOS on them at all
gaps.gap: Real: the Ask HandsFreeOS panel is mounted only in the business layout (apps/web/src/app/app/w/[workspaceId]/layout.tsx:134). AdminShell, the phone's /app/admin screens and /affiliate have no panel. Every Assistant route needs a workspaceId with assistant.use (routes.ts:129, 235, 286). So a support person who isn't in any business gets no Assistant. The phone sends that person straight to the desk (apps/mobile/src/app/app/index.tsx:50); the web sends them to /onboarding (apps/web/src/app/app/page.tsx:8). The same goes for an affiliate who isn't a customer, even though affiliate.apply, make_code and turn_code are offered to everyone (coverage.ts:331-341). Overstated: 'from inside a business it can't know which ticket is on screen'. Inside a business no Admin record is ever on screen, so the missing page types only matter once the panel is mounted in the Admin area. Inside any business they belong to, staff already get every staff read_ and do_ tool (context.ts:339-341) and the staff line (prompt.ts:279). They can name a ticket or business and find its id with read_support_ticket_list or read_platform_business_list. That workaround and the small audience make this medium, not high.
gaps.fix: Left open: it needs the owner’s decision on who pays for questions asked outside any business (the Assistant charges a business’s wallet), and then workspaceId made optional on every Assistant route and the panel mounted in AdminShell, the phone’s admin layout and /affiliate. Inside any business they belong to, staff already get every staff tool and the staff line.

gaps.where: Admin area → Founding, Waiting for a decision: Approve on a paid offer, then the 'Copy the link' dialog (the claim link, shown once)
gaps.gap: founding.approve is offered to staff as do_founding_approve (coverage.ts:303). For a paid offer it returns claimToken once and stores only its hash (founding.ts:628, 713-744). Nothing emails it: no worker handler sends the link. The screen's dialog tells staff to copy it into an email (founding-words.ts:142-143). commitScreenAction throws the command's output away and returns { outcome: 'Done', href: null } (tools-screen-actions.ts:131-136). The confirm route returns and stores only outcome and href (routes.ts:351-358). So after an approval through the Assistant the link is gone for good. The application is now 'approved', so approving again is refused with founding_application_decided (founding.ts:637-642), and the seat stays reserved until it lapses. The card's warning 'A free seat goes on their business at once.' is wrong for a paid offer. The command's own description promises 'the claim link … is returned once'.
gaps.fix: In tools-write.ts:912, pass extra and webUrl to commitScreenAction, as confirmTools get them. In commitScreenAction, keep executeCommand's output. For founding.approve, when output.claimToken is set, return outcome 'Approved. Their seat is held until <expiresAt as a date>. Send them this claim link now: it isn’t shown again.' Return the link `${webUrl}${foundingClaimPath(claimToken)}` in a new CommittedAction field (e.g. `shownOnce: { label: 'Claim link', value }`). routes.ts:357 returns that field in out() but never passes it to store.updateToolCall, so it stays out of the stored record like the command receipt. Change coverage.ts:303's warning to: 'A free seat goes on their business at once. A paid one is held for them, and its claim link shows on this card once, after you confirm: copy it into an email to them.'

gaps.where: Sell HandsFreeOS (/affiliate): 'Your link' copy field and each code's 'Copy link'; Admin area → Affiliates: each row's link, and an affiliate's page Link card and code links
gaps.gap: The screens show full links: affiliateLink(code) = `${AFFILIATE_SITE}/?ref=<code>` (affiliates/words.ts:23) and affiliateCodeLink(code) with the code parameter (affiliates/codes.ts:20). They appear at affiliate-self.tsx:154, affiliates-page.tsx:289, affiliate-detail.tsx:135 and affiliate-codes.tsx:90. read_affiliate_mine, read_platform_affiliates and read_platform_affiliate return the queries' output unchanged (tools-screen-reads.ts has no link handling). That output carries only `code`: rowOut at queries/affiliates.ts:92-115, affiliate.mine at :368-384, and AffiliateCodeRow at schemas/affiliates.ts:151-167. The '?ref=' shape is only in a code comment (schemas/affiliates.ts:53), which the model never sees. Nothing in the prompt or places-map gives the link's form. The prompt's only link example is https://handsfreeos.com/book/acme (prompt.ts:49), which invites a guessed path.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_affiliate_mine, read_platform_affiliates and read_platform_affiliate add each affiliate’s link, and each code’s link while it’s on, on HandsFreeOS’s own website (withAffiliateLinks in tools-screen-reads.ts, from the public-links work). An affiliate’s own link shows only once they are approved and have agreed to the terms, as their page shows it.

gaps.where: Confirm cards for every Admin area action: Put a credit on <business>, Move <business> to…, Give <business> a founding seat, Revoke, an affiliate's share, Send it on a ticket, and others
gaps.gap: Staff screen actions keep their ids in the input on purpose (screen-actions.ts:42: staff gives { input, scope: [] }). prepareScreenAction draws the card with cardFields(tool, args) (tools-screen-actions.ts:118). cardFields labels each key with labelOf ('workspaceId' becomes 'Workspace id', 'amountCents' becomes 'Amount cents', 'maxDiscountBp' becomes 'Max discount bp') and prints the value raw: a UUID, a number of cents or basis points, or an enum like 'enforce' (tools-addons.ts:118-156). Nothing resolves a name. So the Confirm card for risk-4 wallet.adjust, wallet.set_stage, founding.approve/give/revoke and affiliate.set_rate/set_max_discount shows a UUID and raw units, not the business or person, an amount in dollars, or a percentage. These risk-4 actions are offered deliberately (owner 2026-10-27, coverage.ts:261; the test requires a warning on each, assistant-coverage.test.ts:136), so the settled risk-4 rule doesn't refute this.
gaps.fix: Fixed: a staff confirm card names what it acts on (staffCardFields in staff-cards.ts): the business, person, ticket, affiliate, application, seat, offer, invitation, idea and add-on by name, an amount in dollars (Credit or Take back for a balance), a share as a percentage, and a stage, status, priority or role in the screens’ words. The ids never show; a name that can’t be looked up falls back to the plain line.

gaps.where: Admin area → Businesses → a business → Their balance → Put a credit on (How much, Why?)
gaps.gap: WalletAdjustInput.reference is required and has no .describe() (the explanation is only a JSDoc comment, invisible to the model), so do_wallet_adjust makes the model invent one (schemas/wallet.ts:150-152). The screen makes a fresh one per dialog with deskCreditReference(workspaceId) = admin:<workspaceId>:<now> (business-words.ts:260; wallet-block.tsx:111). private.staff_credit_wallet writes idempotency_key 'credit:'||reference with on conflict do nothing and returns recorded=false (20260930001200_support_can_credit_a_balance.sql). commitScreenAction ignores the output and says 'Done' (tools-screen-actions.ts:135). So a second credit with a reused reference like 'goodwill' is silently not recorded.
gaps.fix: Fixed: wallet.adjust’s reference is filled (SCREEN_ACTIONS filled), so the model never gives it. The worker puts on assistant:<business>:<card id> at prepare and at Confirm (staffKept), so the same card confirmed twice is one credit and says so; a new card is a new credit. Done says the new balance.

gaps.where: Admin area → Ideas → an idea → Comments: each comment's Take down / Put back, with the author's name and the Taken down tag
gaps.gap: do_idea_set_comment_hidden is offered to everyone (coverage.ts:117) and needs commentId. The only read of comments is find_ideas with ideaId, which calls idea.get. idea.get returns each comment's id, author name and hidden flag, and includes hidden comments for moderators (queries/ideas.ts:243-255, 314-325). findIdeas drops hidden comments, keeps only .slice(-10) without saying so, drops id and hidden, and labels authors 'HandsFreeOS team', 'You' or 'Someone' (tools-extra.ts:1471-1478). idea.get isn't in SCREEN_READS, and idea.triage and idea.team_view have no comments. So no tool yields a commentId: neither a person taking down their own comment nor staff moderating can do it, and staff can't see what was taken down, although the team screen shows it (idea-team-view.tsx:304-314).
gaps.fix: Fixed: find_ideas gives each comment its commentId (what do_idea_set_comment_hidden takes), the author’s name or You, the HandsFreeOS team tag, and to the team the taken-down ones marked takenDown (idea.get gives those only to moderators). It shows the last 10 and says how many earlier ones there are; allComments gives every one.

gaps.where: Admin area → Support people → 'How you sign off' (Your name to customers, Sign-off, Save)
gaps.gap: The 'How you sign off' card loads displayName and signature from platform.me (apps/web/src/app/admin/staff/page.tsx:11-21). platform.me is kept from the Assistant (screen-reads.ts:146) because it 'already knows' staff status. But the context reads only role and permissions from it (context.ts:120-123, 337), and nothing passes the signature on. support.staff.list's StaffMember has displayName but no signature (schemas/support.ts:198-207). StaffProfileInput.signature defaults to '' (schemas/support.ts:240-243), and the handler writes both fields (support-staff.ts:297-300). So do_support_staff_save_profile with only a new displayName wipes the sign-off, and the Assistant can't read the current one to keep it.
gaps.fix: Fixed: platform.me is a screen read now, offered to staff alone (support.read): their name to customers, sign-off as saved, role and permissions. do_support_staff_save_profile keeps the saved sign-off when the model leaves it out (staffKept), so changing only the name never wipes it.

gaps.where: Admin area → Ideas → Areas: each area's description and open count, the Archived tag, Archive / Bring back, and Add an area
gaps.gap: The Areas screen resends id, name, description, sort and archived from what it read (idea-areas-admin.tsx:92-99). idea_area.save upserts every column, setting description and sort from the input (commands/ideas.ts:632-640). IdeaAreaSaveInput defaults description to '' and sort to 500 (schemas/ideas.ts:294-301). The Assistant's only read of areas is find_ideas, which keeps archived=false areas and returns only { id, name } (tools-extra.ts:1500-1502). idea.areas already returns description, sort, archived and openCount (queries/ideas.ts:472-506), but it isn't in SCREEN_READS. So archiving or renaming through do_idea_area_save wipes the description and moves the area to 500, and an archived area can't be found to bring back.
gaps.fix: Fixed: idea.areas is a screen read (read_idea_areas): every area with its description, sort, archived state and open count. do_idea_area_save keeps the description, sort and archived state the model leaves out as they are now (staffKept), and says so in its description.

gaps.where: Admin area → Businesses → a business → Add-ons in testing: each add-on still being built, with 'they can add it' / 'not handed out' and Let them try it / Take back
gaps.gap: The Add-ons in testing block lists ADDON_CATALOG filtered to development, beta and built (addon-testing-block.tsx:9-11). platform.business.get returns only the grants already given, as addonGrants (queries/platform.ts:227-241). get_settings add_ons shows only 'available' add-ons, without ids (tools-settings.ts:45-66). addon_pick.overview's comingSoon covers only add-ons picked by vote. So the Assistant can't say which add-ons can be handed out. do_addon_grant_give takes a bare addonId regex (schemas/addon.ts:11), so the model has to guess. Lowered to low because a wrong guess fails safely: it's refused with addon_unknown 'HandsFreeOS has no add-on by that name. Pick one from the list.' (addon-grant.ts:24-30), and ids are usually the lowercased name.
gaps.fix: Fixed: read_platform_business_get adds addonsInTesting: every add-on still being built (development, beta or built), each with they can add it or not handed out, as the page lists them. addon_grant.give’s refusal for an unknown add-on says where that list is.

gaps.where: Settings → Account → Notifications: 'New support tickets' is shown only to HandsFreeOS support people
gaps.gap: update_my_alerts is offered to everyone (permission 'assistant.use'). Its description includes PUSH_WORDS, which names 'supportTickets: a new HandsFreeOS support ticket (HandsFreeOS support people only)', and its enum is all of PUSH_SWITCHES, supportTickets included (tools-extra.ts:95-96, 406-418). Nothing in context.ts or tools-write.ts filters it for people who aren't staff. That tells every business user about a staff-only switch, which goes against the owner's rule (prompt.ts:146-147) that nobody else is told staff tools exist.
gaps.fix: Fixed: update_my_alerts no longer takes or mentions supportTickets. update_my_support_alerts, offered only with support.read, turns New support tickets on or off, and the settings catalog points notifications.support_tickets at it. get_settings my_account leaves the row and its saved switch out for anyone who isn’t staff (platform.me). The core test checks nobody else is offered it or told of it, and assistant-staff.test.ts that get_settings doesn’t tell them.
